text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Winning with overwhelming strength, Mejiro 
Ramonu. Both the spectators and contenders 
marveled at her power, pinning their hopes 
on the first-ever Triple Tiara in history.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Intoxicated by the heat of the race, 
Mejiro Ramonu craves an even greater high.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Next up at last is the first leg of the 
Triple Tiara, the Oka Sho. The two of them 
prepare for the coming battle.
